title: Replace manual channel ring bookkeeping with a preallocated VecDeque and direct message moves
evidence: channel.rs:10-44 initializes Vec<Option<T>> and separate head, tail, len fields; :63-80 retains this duplicate ring state.
try_send at :85-103 and send_timeout at :105-149 duplicate enqueue bookkeeping; timed send wraps an always-retained T in Option and takes it only on paths that immediately return.
take_head at :251-258 manually clears an occupied slot, advances head and decrements len. Admission already rejects at configured capacity under the same mutex.

Official std docs checked 2026-09-06: VecDeque::capacity is the element count available without reallocation, and try_reserve_exact (stable since Rust 1.57) guarantees sufficient capacity after success while returning allocation/overflow errors: https://doc.rust-lang.org/std/collections/struct.VecDeque.html#method.try_reserve_exact . Physical spare capacity may exceed the request, so configured logical capacity must remain separate.
proposal: Use std::collections::VecDeque<T> with fallible up-front reserve and retain a separate configured logical capacity. Admit push_back only when queue.len() < configured capacity; pop_front under the existing lock. This preserves fixed backing after construction and removes head/tail/len/Option-slot state. Carry the timed-send message directly as T and move it only in terminal return branches; unify duplicate expiry handling locally. Preserve all channel outcome and telemetry semantics. Estimated reduction 20-40 lines; do not build a generic channel framework.
required_contract_changes: None for message count, order, wakeups, custody, or timeout behavior. Preserve explicit representability/allocation failures before backing allocation; do not quietly alter endpoint-close lifecycle.
verification: On implementation: existing capacity/FIFO, exact Full/Timeout/Closed messages, zero and unrepresentable deadline, backpressure, closure and high-water tests; add focused non-Copy/drop-count custody and repeated wraparound evidence if the representation change needs it.
Check no push can exceed configured capacity even when VecDeque allocates a larger physical capacity; keep callbacks/destructors out of locked mutation paths.

title: Remove page-lease generation machinery used only as test instrumentation
evidence: page.rs:32,63,77-88,94,119-123,137,187-189,246-247 stores a monotonic number, branches on exhaustion, and exports it on each lease.

Serena PageLease::generation references plus scoped textual follow-up found only stream test :23 and app provider_broker_channel test :83,127,141,187; no production consumer. App test body :76-197 was additionally inspected.

The app custody test already proves exact fragment bytes/context, one-page occupancy, release to zero, successful subsequent work, high-water 1, and total_leases 2. Package/system bounded-dataflow contracts require transferable owned pages, bounded residency and observable lease counts, not per-lease numeric identity.
proposal: Delete generation state, take_generation, accessor, and GenerationExhausted error. Keep non-cloneable PageLease ownership and existing total_leases diagnostics. Replace generation-specific test assertions with unchanged total_leases while custody is outstanding and exact bytes/occupancy/release checks. This removes a permanent exhaustion failure unrelated to available pages. Estimated reduction 25-35 source/test lines.
required_contract_changes: Public API removal of PageLease::generation and PagePoolError::GenerationExhausted; Operator acceptance should record the boundary removal if adopted. No current authoritative product/system requirement needs numeric page generations.
Update the named app custody test in the eventual implementation slice; it was inspected for references only and is outside this worker's coverage inventory.
verification: On implementation: confirm full-workspace reference search after removal; focused stream and provider_broker_channel nextest targets preserve exact returned payload, no re-lease during handoff, release and later reuse.

title: Retain strongly typed model domains and existing small macros
evidence: All 16 model source/test files were inspected in full, including macro definitions and every invocation, validated serde constructors, digest hashing, checked arithmetic and fixed vectors.
IDs already share one text/serde macro; revisions, external strings, fixed digests and CAS generations already use narrow macros.

SequentialMarkerSummaryV1 and DraftMarkerCommitmentV1 have similar fields but explicitly different digest semantics; AssetId, full content digest, accepted identity and promoted owner proof remain distinct authoritative domains.
proposal: Retain these value boundaries. A universal newtype/generic validation framework or wholesale identity replacement would obscure domain separation and exact serialization while removing little beyond existing macros. Keep pure cross-platform admitted path syntax validation; std::path alone cannot validate foreign runtime syntax. Small getter/roundtrip tests are concise public-boundary evidence, and there are no source-text shape scans in these test files.
verification: Full body inspection only; no builds/tests run.

title: Retain channel custody outcomes and weak observation; no wholesale channel dependency proposed
evidence: Full ring construction, send/receive wait loops, both endpoint drops, weak observation and diagnostics bodies inspected.

Stream package design explicitly requires exact retained messages for rejected sends, distinct immediate full vs timeout, endpoint wakeups, content-free counters and only standard library plus error-derive dependencies.
Existing tests cover order, backpressure, blocked-sender receiver drop, sender drain before close, zero/unrepresentable deadlines, and backing-size overflow.
proposal: Retain these boundaries and the current small synchronous wrapper. MS-002 can simplify its private storage using std without introducing another dependency or telemetry adapter. No external channel crate recommendation is claimed or researched; a library switch would first need a quantified reduction after preserving fallible backing admission and exact observer semantics. Local tests repeat two blocking-send arrangements, but a generic concurrency harness would add more surface than it removes.
verification: Full body inspection only; no builds/tests run.
Coverage caveat: two test readiness loops spin until send_waits becomes nonzero with no local deadline; do not treat them as evidence that all regressions terminate promptly.
